newsitem.title: UK: Regent Eastern Europe fund raises $32 mln.
newsitem.headline: Regent Eastern Europe fund raises $32 mln.

text.p: Regent Pacific said on Tuesday its Regent Eastern Europe Leveraged Fund had raised $32 million by July 11 after being launched on July 1.
It said the open-ended Cayman Island investment company would look to make relatively high returns from a diversified portfolio of Eastern European debt.

The principal countries in which it will invest will include Russia, Ukraine, Romania, Bulgaria, Turkey, Moldova, Hungary and Poland. Regent said dollar yields in the region were currently between 12 and 23 percent.
The fund is open to subscriptions on a weekly basis.
